title: Separate Backend Development and Production Claims
stopConditions: A Backend readiness claim relies on the local in-memory server as production evidence.
A storage or PDF export claim omits auth, tenant, size, queue, renderer, or persistence provider limits.
Project Control would promote Backend truth without a Backend-owned readiness contract.
verificationTarget: Backend evidence distinguishes local dev readiness from production service readiness across HTTP, storage, auth, and export boundaries.
summary: Backend service readiness boundary is recorded: development readiness is explicit, local/integration evidence remains bounded, and production service readiness stays blocked.
